name: motion-number-upvotes
title: Animated Upvote Counter
blurb: Count increments with animated number display.
description: A counter button that animates the numeric value up/down using Framer Motion's AnimatePresence and slide transitions.
use_when: You need a like/upvote counter with satisfying number animation.
avoid_when: When smooth, subtle transitions are needed; the number jumps are pronounced.
a11y: Button with aria-label for voting. Animated number is secondary; the count value should be in the label.
